Binary logistic regression

Source: R/blr-regress.R
blr_regress.Rd

Binary logistic regression.

Usage

blr_regress(object, ...)

# Default S3 method
blr_regress(
  object,
  data,
  odd_conf_limit = FALSE,
  weights = NULL,
  offset = NULL,
  ...
)

# S3 method for class 'glm'
blr_regress(object, odd_conf_limit = FALSE, ...)

Arguments

object

An object of class "formula" (or one that can be coerced to that class): a symbolic description of the model to be fitted or class glm with binomial family and logit link. Weighted models (any prior weight other than 1) and grouped binomial models (cbind(successes, failures) or proportions) are not supported; refit models stored without their model frame or response using glm(..., model = TRUE, y = TRUE).

...

Other inputs.

data

A data.frame or tibble containing the variables in the model.

odd_conf_limit

If TRUE, odds ratio confidence limits will be displayed.

weights

An optional vector of prior weights to be used in the fitting process.

offset

An optional offset to be included in the model.

Details

The default method fits a binomial logit model with glm. An offset may be supplied directly, and the formula environment is kept. When a fitted glm object is supplied, the fit is summarised directly, so an offset supplied through the model formula and the formula environment are respected. Weighted models are rejected by the shared model guard.

Odds ratio confidence limits are profile-likelihood intervals computed by confint.

Examples

# using formula
blr_regress(object = honcomp ~ female + read + science, data = hsb2)
#>                              Model Overview                              
#> ------------------------------------------------------------------------
#> Data Set    Resp Var    Obs.    Df. Model    Df. Residual    Convergence 
#> ------------------------------------------------------------------------
#>   data      honcomp     200         3            196            TRUE     
#> ------------------------------------------------------------------------
#> 
#>                     Response Summary                     
#> --------------------------------------------------------
#> Outcome        Frequency        Outcome        Frequency 
#> --------------------------------------------------------
#>    0              147              1              53     
#> --------------------------------------------------------
#> 
#>                   Maximum Likelihood Estimates                    
#> -----------------------------------------------------------------
#>  Parameter     DF    Estimate    Std. Error    z value    Pr(>|z|) 
#> -----------------------------------------------------------------
#> (Intercept)    1     -12.7772       1.9755    -6.4677      0.0000 
#>   female1      1      1.4825        0.4474     3.3139       9e-04 
#>    read        1      0.1035        0.0258     4.0186       1e-04 
#>   science      1      0.0948        0.0305     3.1129      0.0019 
#> -----------------------------------------------------------------
#> 
#>  Association of Predicted Probabilities and Observed Responses  
#> ---------------------------------------------------------------
#> % Concordant         85.6116          Somers' D        0.7136   
#> % Discordant         14.2472          Gamma            0.7147   
#> % Tied                0.1412          Tau-a            0.2794   
#> Pairs                  7791           c                0.8568   
#> ---------------------------------------------------------------
#> 

# using a model built with glm
model <- glm(honcomp ~ female + read + science, data = hsb2,
             family = binomial(link = 'logit'))

blr_regress(model)
#>                              Model Overview                              
#> ------------------------------------------------------------------------
#> Data Set    Resp Var    Obs.    Df. Model    Df. Residual    Convergence 
#> ------------------------------------------------------------------------
#>   hsb2      honcomp     200         3            196            TRUE

#> --------------------------------------------------------

#> --------------------------------------------------------

#>                   Maximum Likelihood Estimates                    
#> -----------------------------------------------------------------
#>  Parameter     DF    Estimate    Std. Error    z value    Pr(>|z|) 
#> -----------------------------------------------------------------

#>   female1      1      1.4825        0.4474     3.3139       9e-04

#>   science      1      0.0948        0.0305     3.1129      0.0019 
#> -----------------------------------------------------------------

#> % Tied                0.1412          Tau-a            0.2794   
#> Pairs                  7791           c                0.8568   
#> ---------------------------------------------------------------
#> 

# odds ratio estimates
blr_regress(model, odd_conf_limit = TRUE)
